display.purpose: Channel readings and the product bezel title.

label.purpose: Uppercase controls, status, and channel names.

body.purpose: Help, empty, loading, error, and explanatory text.

motion.name: fast-state
motion.purpose: Immediate button, border, and control feedback.

motion.name: trace-write
motion.purpose: One-time pen advance when a new trace series loads; skipped under reduced motion.

components.name: Primary Run Button
components.description: Arms a backtest or Optuna recorder channel.
components.css: .ds-button-primary { min-height: 36px; padding: var(--space-sm) var(--space-md); border: 1px solid var(--color-trace-amber); border-radius: var(--radius-md); color: var(--color-trace-amber); background: var(--color-panel); font: 600 var(--text-label-size)/1.2 var(--font-mono); letter-spacing: 0.1em; text-transform: uppercase; transition: background var(--duration-fast) var(--ease-out-expo); } .ds-button-primary:hover { background: var(--color-panel-raised); } .ds-button-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-text-primary); outline-offset: 1px; }

components.name: Danger Button
components.description: Arms live trading only after the exact confirmation phrase.
components.css: .ds-button-danger { min-height: 36px; padding: var(--space-sm) var(--space-md); border: 1px solid var(--color-negative); border-radius: var(--radius-md); color: var(--color-negative); background: var(--color-panel); font: 600 var(--text-label-size)/1.2 var(--font-mono); letter-spacing: 0.1em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-button-danger:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-text-primary); outline-offset: 1px; }

components.name: Instrument Input
components.description: Compact dark control with a visible neutral focus ring.
components.css: .ds-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: var(--space-xs); color: var(--color-text-dim); font: 600 var(--text-label-size)/1.2 var(--font-mono); letter-spacing: 0.12em; } .ds-field input { min-height: 36px; padding: var(--space-xs) var(--space-sm); border: 1px solid var(--color-hairline); border-radius: var(--radius-sm); color: var(--color-text-primary); background: var(--color-void); font: 400 var(--text-body-size)/1.5 var(--font-mono); } .ds-field input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-text-primary); outline-offset: 1px; }

components.name: Feed Status Tag
components.description: Text-first connection state; unknown and stale states never resemble safe data.
components.css: .ds-status-tag { display: inline-block; padding: 2px 6px; border: 1px solid var(--color-negative); border-radius: var(--radius-sm); color: var(--color-negative); background: var(--color-panel-raised); font: 600 var(--text-label-size)/1.2 var(--font-mono); letter-spacing: 0.12em; text-transform: uppercase; }

components.name: Instrument Bezel
components.css: .ds-bezel { display: flex; align-items: baseline; justify-content: space-between; gap: var(--space-md); height: var(--bezel-height); padding: var(--space-md) var(--space-xl); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--color-hairline); color: var(--color-text-primary); background: var(--color-panel-raised); font-family: var(--font-mono); } .ds-bezel span { color: var(--color-negative); font-size: var(--text-label-size); letter-spacing: 0.12em; }

components.name: Channel Strip
components.description: Pinned reading rail beside a paper trace surface.
components.css: .ds-channel { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 160px 1fr; gap: var(--space-md); padding: var(--space-md); border: 1px solid var(--color-hairline); border-radius: var(--radius-md); background: var(--color-panel); } .ds-channel > div { display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: center; gap: var(--space-xs); padding-inline-end: var(--space-md); border-inline-end: 1px solid var(--color-hairline); } .ds-channel span { color: var(--color-text-dim); font: 600 var(--text-label-size)/1.2 var(--font-mono); letter-spacing: 0.12em; } .ds-channel strong { color: var(--color-trace-amber); font: 600 var(--text-display-size)/1.1 var(--font-mono); } .ds-channel figure { min-height: 140px; margin: 0; border: 1px solid var(--color-hairline); border-radius: var(--radius-sm); background: var(--color-paper); }

narrative.overview: This dashboard is built as an analog seismograph / strip-chart recorder: a bank of instruments in a near-black housing, each channel a continuous pen trace on scrolling paper, each risk threshold a literal banded zone the trace must not cross. It exists to prove the system's fixed risk rails on sight. This is Operate-mode instrumentation, so expression never outranks the numbers.
keyCharacteristics: Near-black instrument housing, warm off-white numerals, three reserved trace hues
Monospace-first: every number that could sit in a column does
Flat panel layering instead of shadows; grain/graticule texture instead of gradients
Threshold bands are drawn geometry at their real value, never decorative color blocks

rules.name: The Reserved-Channel Rule
rules.body: Trace Amber, Cyan, and Violet are bound one-to-one to the equity/PnL, ML-performance, and regime channels. Amber is additionally allowed on the primary run action because that action arms a recorder channel. Selection, focus, connection, and navigation states use Text Primary or semantic status colors, never a reserved trace hue.

rules.name: The Threshold-Is-Not-Decoration Rule
rules.body: Threshold colors render as geometry positioned at a real risk-rail value with a label naming the rule.

rules.name: The Tabular-Numerals Rule
rules.body: Every numeral that could align in a column uses tabular numerals.

rules.name: The No-Glow Rule
rules.body: Depth comes from panel layering and hairline borders, never shadows or blur.

dos: Do reserve Trace Amber / Cyan / Violet for their defined data and action roles.
Do use tabular numerals on every column of numbers.
Do position threshold bands at their real risk-rail value, and label every one.
Do render disconnected or stale broker/API state as STATUS UNKNOWN; never substitute an empty or safe reading.
donts: Don't use box-shadow, blur, backdrop-filter, or glassmorphism anywhere.
Don't default to rounded-xl/rounded-2xl or pill-shaped controls.
Don't reuse a Reserved Channel color as a generic UI accent outside its channel.
Don't let the live-trading action button become clickable before the exact confirmation phrase is typed.
